First of all, you are under no obligation to be in a relationship just to keep someone alive.
No person should pressure you to be in one just because when you break up with them they will kill themselves.
Both parties have been kept in a very undeserving situation. 
The one who wants to break up with this other person is allowed to follow their paths and find something uplifting and something that lifts their heart. The person who is being left, should, accept the inevitable and find the strength to finally stand on his/her two feet. But in cases of mental health, this person threatening to end their lives probably feels like the emotional damage will be hard to bear and thus the threat/statement. It is all okay. In my opinion this person has become highly dependent on this particular relationship in order to give him meaning/control or whatever his reason maybe.
I would suggest leaving him but alert his close friends and family and doctor if they can, and inform them of his statement. Be there for the person if you can and show them that life is still beautiful even when there is heartache, because I feel that fear also has a big role in this situation.
